notes.title: REGULAR DEMO UPDATE (AUG 2025)
notes.content: [h3][b]HELLO AGAIN, MEOWCOLYTES![/b][/h3][p][/p][h1][b]WE GOT 2 NEW LEVELS AND A BRAND NEW MAIN MENU!!!!! 😼🧙‍♂️[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102668/f012fe0f82655ac33e238071895b67425ecc5b6e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're starting to get into a nice groove with these updates, and we hope you're enjoying what we're putting out as much as we enjoy working on it ₍^. .^₎⟆[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]LEADERBOARDS HAVE BEEN RESET TOO, GO GET YOUR NAMES UP THERE!!![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 2 new levels to the demo (new total of 12 levels)[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements & changes to existing levels (based on feedback)[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the Main Menu [i]including brand new menu music[/i] (world space UI woot woot!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new buttons to main menu (wishlist, discord, and feedback form)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated our globally used font (ooOoOoOo)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Paws (Pause) & Credits Menus[/p][/*][*][p]Improved rocks, slides, & floors (textures, meshes, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved light baking settings (aesthetics, performance)[/p][/*][*][p]Changed cat replay color to be blue! (from orange)[/p][/*][*][p]First gameplay soundtrack no longer has an extra 15-20s of silence before looping[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay soundtracks now transition properly and consistently[/p][/*][*][p]Some UI buttons were missing hover sfx (and now they aren't)[/p][/*][*][p][i]and minor optimizations here and there :)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, thank you for the continued sup-pawrt... heh.[/p][p][/p][p]: ¨·.·¨ :[/p][p] ` ·. 🦋[/p][p]                  ╱|、                   [/p][p]                (˚ˎ 。7  [/p][p]                 |、˜〵          [/p][p]                じしˍ,)ノ           [/p][p][/p][p][b]Keep up the Meowmentum,[/b][/p][p][b]PurrfectPace Interactive[/b][/p]

notes.title: POST TWITCH EVENT DEMO UPDATE (JUL 2025)
notes.content: [h1]HELLO HELLO, MEOWCOLYTES! [/h1][p][/p][h3]For this smaller update we still have our usual [b]10 levels[/b], but with slight updated visuals, and LOTS of optimization! [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102668/0274fc2996b4b7d201ce557f7e8cdea1c144ad63.gif"][/img][/p][p]Once again thank you for being here <3 Now lets talk about some of the changes:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Due to changes in the levels, THE [b]LEADERBOARDS GOT RESET[/b] SO GO GET YOUR BEST TIMES RIGHT MEOW![/p][/*][*][p]A LOT of [b]optimization[/b] through GPU batching! Things should be running much smoother than before. This will  mean bye bye to our glowing walls for the time being.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New meshes[/b] for our cat beds! Fresher look with a faster vibe. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvements on the levels[/b] based on feedback and playtesting from our last in-person event (Twitch Vancouver Technological Exploration)[/p][/*][/list][p]A smaller update but we are incredibly excited for more people to be able to play with our optimization efforts!  [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your continued support! We wouldn't be here without you. ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][p][b]Keep up the Meowmentum,[/b][/p][p][b]PurrfectPace Interactive[/b][/p]

notes.title: POST-HIBERNATION DEMO UPDATE (JUN 2025)
notes.content:
[h1][b]HELLO AGAIN, MEOWCOLYTES![/b][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102668/2a1dbde90e02ee8e31462af7b9e1514ce9130ba1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]We're back with a [i][b]hot new demo[/b][/i] consisting of 10 levels, updated visuals, silly dancing cats, and lots of other minor improvements!!![/h3][h3][/h3][p]It certainly has been a while, and we're happy to see you here, old and new players alike! It's been an interesting few months for us, as the update from Unity 2022.3 to Unity 6 came with plenty of challenges -> but fear not, for this update will be the first of several to come this year :)[/p][p]
[b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated Unity version (2022.3 -> 6)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved backend optimization (networking stuff)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved accuracy of replay system (the lil orange glowy cat)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved retention of momentum logic (more consistent)[/p][/*][*][p]Added 4 new levels to the demo[/p][/*][*][p]Re-arranged level order to better consider overall progression/NUX[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked level gameplay flow (restart, auto-countdown -> restart, freeze camera and start timer with player input)[/p][/*][*][p]Made several iterations to each level (based on playtesting/feedback)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tutorialization using world-space UI (text)[/p][/*][*][p]Focused on getting closer to goal aesthetics with new foreground & background set dressing (e.g. cat balloons)[/p][/*][*][p]Added more dynamic environmental objects (e.g. meownions that dance faster based on your speed, walls that glow when you're nearby/going fast, balloons that gently move up and down)[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked lighting (currently 3 types: morning, afternoon, night)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated post-processing volumes (sky, clouds, ocean, global, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting/mesh baking pipelines (efficiency, woo!)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated/replaced several old meshes and textures[/p][/*][*][p]Started replacing often-repeated meshes with modular kits (e.g. walls)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated outdated & created new SFX (UI, environment, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added dynamic stems to every music track that only play if you're going fast enough[/p][/*][*][p]Updated all level select portal screenshots[/p][/*][*][p]Added 'Join our Discord Server' button to the menu[/p][/*][*][p]...and more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed all build-breaking bugs (as a result of the engine update)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera being misaligned on restart[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed slide-related movement bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lot of minor bugs... like, a lot.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]YEESH, this update was hefty.[/b] It took a while, but it feels like quite the victory for us. The engine update was a high-risk/high-reward decision, but now we're finally at a point where we get to start reaping more of the benefits. Thank you all for your continued support <3
[/p][p][i]We're stupidly excited for what's to come, so make sure you stick around[/i] ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][p][b]Keep up the Meowmentum,
PurrfectPace Interactive[/b][/p]

notes.title: PRE-HIBERNATION DEMO UPDATE (NOV 2024)
notes.content:
[p][b]Greetings Meowcolytes...[/b]

...and thank you for reading our first update announcement! This is still new to us, so we really really appreciate you being here!!! ːsteamhappyː
[i]Let's start with a basic summary:[/i]

[b]Changes[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Improved Menu and Settings UI
[/p][/*][*][p] Art (mesh) optimizations
[/p][/*][*][p] Reworked/optimized ghost system
[/p][/*][*][p] Level iterations based on player feedback
[/p][/*][*][p] Level 4 and 6 have swapped places for better difficulty progression
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved (internal) demo build pipeline
[/p][/*][*][p] Removed 4-digit identifier at the end of names (profile/leaderboards)
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a NEW music track for levels 4, 5, 6
[/p][/*][*][p] Added dynamic stems in the music that scales its volume with your speed
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Main Menu no longer appears blank when accessed from the Paws menu in-game
[/p][/*][*][p] Runs are no longer saved or later uploaded to the leaderboards when playing offline
[/p][/*][*][p] Profile/Leaderboards no longer have mismatched usernames (rare, but happened)
[/p][/*][/list][p] A big chunk of the changes coming ahead involves a lot of grunt work, as we are updating our Unity engine version. We've always wanted Meowmentum to be as accessible as possible, and the upgrade to Unity 6 makes using HDRP in a performant manner more viable. We wanted to make as many minor improvements as possible before this transition, so that we feel good about where we're leaving off before going full-grind mode internally.  [/p][p][/p][p]We're calling this a pre-hibernation demo because that's really what it is. That being said, we'll still be active on our discord server and might host some internal playtests with new features - [url="https://discord.com/invite/CsT747rUux"]so come chat with us on Discord![/url]

Here's a lil' sneak peek of something we're testing:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102668/d4fd99ef2a84b638de32c3e38769409cb91c7168.gif"][/img]
We'll see you next year!

[b]Keep up the Meowmentum,
PurrfectPace Interactive[/b][/p]
